purpose: Descriptive source TRAIN correspondence report, no learned choice or new labels
permitted_inputs: Only metadata JSONL bound by the two COMPLETE receipts; all185/all1480/all823/all258/all2064 included. No input image/array/eval/weights.

reporting_rules.original_eligible_nominal: original_query_available AND WEAK_INSTANCE_NOMINAL_REFERENCE AND valid_nominal_discrepancy; all excluded counts separately reported
reporting_rules.crop_extent: No tuned threshold; report pre-existing outer crop geometry [-.5,95.5) only
reporting_rules.distance: Continuous descriptive min/p25/median/p75/max only, nominal discrepancy not physical coordinate gold
reporting_rules.other_objects: obj_id intact; not relabeled pallet/no obj1 fallback
